messages:
OncallBot: P1 ALERT — model-serving-west1 503 spike (pager triggered). Incident ticket: INC-17420. /bridge open https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/61234
Alex Chen: picking up — I'm driving for the initial triage.
Tori Patel: I'm mid-handoff, I can stay primary until 04:30 UTC, then will handover. Samir is secondary.
Samir Rahman: ack, standing by for comms unless Alex wants it.
Alex Chen: Samir please own comms. Initial look: queue depth spike + gpu node CPU at ~98% on gpu-04, a few pod restarts.
Alex Chen: runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving/503-spike — following the "scale-and-drain" quick steps.
Alex Chen: commands I'm running: ```kubectl -n model-prod get pods -o wide | grep model
kubectl -n model-prod top pod model-serve-0
```
Tori Patel: noted. Autoscaler logs show failing reconcile around 04:14 UTC, might be RBAC error preventing scale up. Checking controller logs now.
Samir Rahman: @cs-bot can you post a status update draft? Customers likely see increased errors for text-gen / chat endpoints. I'll review before publish.
cs-bot: Draft status: "Partial degradation impacting generation endpoints in west1; engineers investigating." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/drafts/17420
Maria Gomez: I'm on CS — will prep status page and customer pings once you confirm impact and ETA.
Alex Chen: temporary mitigation applied: manually scaled model-deployment to 6 replicas, draining gpu-04 (evicting pods). Monitoring qdepth.
Tori Patel: confirmed manual scale succeeded, replica count now 6. Controller still throwing 403 when attempting automated scale (RBAC).
Samir Rahman: updating incident ticket: impact=partial_degradation; affected=[text-gen, chat-summarize]; percent_traffic_impacted~8%.
Alex Chen: perf after scale: median latency dropping from 4.2s -> 0.9s for queued requests, 503 rate down. Keeping drive for another 10m to verify stability.
Tori Patel: I'll take over as driver at 04:30 UTC — Alex, please hand off then and paste any commands you ran into the ticket.
Alex Chen: handing off: I'm pausing active ops, leaving notes in INC-17420: "scaled to 6 replicas, drained node gpu-04, restarted kube-controller-manager pod once (caused temporary reconcile failures)". @Samir, comms are with you. :thumbsup:
Samir Rahman: Taking comms. Posting status now: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/17420 — ETA for full resolution TBD pending RBAC fix.
Maria Gomez: Posted to status and notified top-10 customers via email template. Will update CS channel with copy.
OncallBot: Reminder: attach logs (controller, autoscaler) and bridge recording to INC-17420.
Tori Patel: I confirm takeover as driver at 04:30 UTC. Plan: revert manual scale once autoscaler/RBAC fixed, then validate sustained traffic for 15m.
Alex Chen: available for 20m post-handoff if anything flares.
Samir Rahman: comms plan: triage update every 15m, final postmortem owner=Alex (RCA + technical writeup), comms owner=Samir (timeline + customer-facing summary).
Maria Gomez: noted. I'll coordinate customer-facing timeline with Samir after incident closes.
Tori Patel: quick runbook note I added: add check for controller RBAC on rollback step 3 — might prevent next occurrence.
Alex Chen: thanks — good handoff. Reactions :white_check_mark:
OncallBot: Incident state: mitigation=in_progress; owner=Alex Chen -> Tori Patel (handoff at 04:30 UTC); comms=Samir Rahman.
Samir Rahman: closing loop — will keep updates in-thread and tag infra/security if we need cross-team support.
Maria Gomez: closing customer notify loop — will send follow-ups after RCA is drafted.
OncallBot: Please remember to fill out the post-incident checklist: https://redwood.internal/oncall/checklist and attach it to INC-17420.
